title: Access Reset
content: To reset access, submit an access reset request through the internal support portal. If access is urgently required, create a support ticket with the affected system name.

title: Password Reset
content: Passwords can be reset using the self-service password portal. After three failed attempts, the account may be temporarily locked.

title: VPN Access
content: VPN access requires an active corporate account and approved network access. Connection failures should first be checked against the VPN service status.

title: Support Ticket
content: A support ticket should include a clear title, problem description, impacted service, and business impact.
